_notes: Durotar open-world named-rare + boss loot (2026-10-21). One item drops per kill from the creature's pool. Numbers from the real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.py); ilvl>=10 so secondary stats are allowed.

Old Redtooth.name: Redtooth's Fang-Knife
Old Redtooth.flavor_text: Pulled from the jaw of the alpha himself. Still thinks it's hunting.

Old Redtooth.name: Rustfang Hunter's Mask
Old Redtooth.flavor_text: Hyena-hide, stitched around a skull that did not need it any more.

Old Redtooth.name: Pack-Mother's Charm
Old Redtooth.flavor_text: Every pack has someone who keeps the others alive. This is what she wore.

Old Redtooth.name: Hauberk of the Alpha
Old Redtooth.flavor_text: Layers of hide and scale. It shrugs off teeth with a sort of smug patience.

Rumblejaw.name: Rumblejaw's Slab
Rumblejaw.flavor_text: A plate of fused ridge-stone. Rattles, faintly, when something big walks by.

Rumblejaw.name: Thunderbitten Staff
Rumblejaw.flavor_text: The wood is petrified. The lightning it holds is not.

Rumblejaw.name: Seer's Stoneplate Bracers
Rumblejaw.flavor_text: Slate bracers. Listen to them and you can hear the ridge settling.

Rumblejaw.name: Quake-Walker's Greaves
Rumblejaw.flavor_text: Heavy plates that don't care how the ground feels about it.

Bloodhoof the Lamed.name: Lamed Outrider's Glaive
Bloodhoof the Lamed.flavor_text: Balanced for a rider with one good leg. Rides on regardless.

Bloodhoof the Lamed.name: Outrider's Hunting Belt
Bloodhoof the Lamed.flavor_text: A Kolkar belt, studded with the tags of every kill he refused to stop counting.

Bloodhoof the Lamed.name: Hoofbeat Greaves
Bloodhoof the Lamed.flavor_text: You can feel a gallop in the soles. Even standing still.

Bloodhoof the Lamed.name: Wrangler's Mending Band
Bloodhoof the Lamed.flavor_text: The ring he used on wounded mounts. It did a lot of mending, in the end.

Matron Sowbelly.name: Farmyard Tenderiser
Matron Sowbelly.flavor_text: A fence-post with ideas. The Matron had opinions about fences.

Matron Sowbelly.name: Sowbelly's Silk Shawl
Matron Sowbelly.flavor_text: Somebody wove this for a farmer's wife. She never got to wear it.

Matron Sowbelly.name: Matron's Ear-Tag
Matron Sowbelly.flavor_text: Iron, numbered, and still warm. She was number one.

Matron Sowbelly.name: Trough-Scrapers
Matron Sowbelly.flavor_text: Plate gauntlets, dented in a way that only makes sense if you have met the Matron.

Gillfin the Net-Cutter.name: Net-Cutter's Hooked Blade
Gillfin the Net-Cutter.flavor_text: Half a sword, half a gaff. Entirely sure which half it prefers.

Gillfin the Net-Cutter.name: Driftwood Harpoon-Crossbow
Gillfin the Net-Cutter.flavor_text: Fires harpoons. The harpoons are mostly spite.

Gillfin the Net-Cutter.name: Tidewrack Wristwraps
Gillfin the Net-Cutter.flavor_text: Dry-rotted netting, enchanted by someone with a long memory of drowning.

Gillfin the Net-Cutter.name: Pearl of the Net-Cutter
Gillfin the Net-Cutter.flavor_text: Pried from a clam that took it personally.

Houndmaster Kraygh.name: Kraygh's Felwhip Wand
Houndmaster Kraygh.flavor_text: The leather's burned into the grip. It cracks even when you're not holding it.

Houndmaster Kraygh.name: Houndmaster's Fel-Pistol
Houndmaster Kraygh.flavor_text: Fires something that mends the hounds. You've just decided it mends you instead.

Houndmaster Kraygh.name: Kennel-Keeper's Plate
Houndmaster Kraygh.flavor_text: Spiked and scorched in all the places a hound likes to bite.

Houndmaster Kraygh.name: Netherfire Handwraps
Houndmaster Kraygh.flavor_text: They glow when the dark is close. They're glowing now.

Warlord Krellian.name: Krellian's Cleaver
Warlord Krellian.flavor_text: A Kolkar war-axe, longer than the hand that held it.

Warlord Krellian.name: Warlord's Hierophant Cloak
Warlord Krellian.flavor_text: Sun-faded scarlet. Smells of smoke, hides, and a prayer to someone who stopped answering.

Warlord Krellian.name: Crag-Scale Legguards
Warlord Krellian.flavor_text: Mail laced with small plates, each stamped with a Kolkar brand.

Warlord Krellian.name: Kolkar Horn Bow
Warlord Krellian.flavor_text: Drawn from the horn of a beast older than the Kolkar are.

Stormhide Patriarch.name: Patriarch's Thunderhammer
Stormhide Patriarch.flavor_text: The spark inside never goes out. It's been trying to for a while.

Stormhide Patriarch.name: Stormhide Pauldrons
Stormhide Patriarch.flavor_text: Thick, static-crackling hide. Rubs the wrong way on cold mornings.

Stormhide Patriarch.name: Cracked-Plate Girdle
Stormhide Patriarch.flavor_text: Scales fused into a belt by a bolt of lightning that nobody asked for.

Stormhide Patriarch.name: Storm-Eye Idol
Stormhide Patriarch.flavor_text: Stare at it long enough and it stares back with the weather.
